note: [LLM critic, medium conf] The AI shot a weak bolt rifle at Custodian Guard Delta for 0.3 expected damage. Both options score the same 0.17, and the already_allocated bonus of 2.17 causes a pile-on on a unit that cannot realistically die. Fix: Count already_allocated only when the combined expected damage of the allocated units can reach the kill threshold. Otherwise prefer the target with the best kill chance or the most valuable wounded model, such as the Blade Champion with 7 HP and 8.6 in range, inside the rapid fire half range.
